**score 43.3** ±0.9

#139 of 205 · from 33 benchmark results across 12 sources

## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

api (Deep Infra) · $0.13/M blended · $0.08 in / $0.28 out per 1M tokens · [deepinfra.com ↗](https://deepinfra.com/models)

[price source](https://github.com/anomalyco/models.dev/blob/a668908cfe7073faa0363699486fc41a3ff52412/providers/deepinfra/models/Qwen/Qwen3-32B.toml) · Standard base token rate from models.dev. Provider-specific tiers, long-context surcharges, caching and promotions may differ.

[context specification source](https://github.com/anomalyco/models.dev/blob/a668908cfe7073faa0363699486fc41a3ff52412/models/alibaba/qwen3-32b.toml)

| local download | size | score | command |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| 4-bit q4\_k\_m | ~20.18GB | 43.3 | `ollama run qwen3:32b` |
| 8-bit q8\_0 | ~39.86GB | 43.3 | `ollama run qwen3:32b-q8_0` |

The score is the published model's; quantized downloads haven't been evaluated separately.
